svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Four ways a firm can respond to conflicting digital rules: three placed by global integration and local responsiveness, and leaving the market
svg.desc: A two-by-two grid with global integration on the vertical axis and local responsiveness on the horizontal axis, with firms shown by their logos. High integration, low responsiveness: one product everywhere, with Apple's USB-C on every iPhone in 2023 and Microsoft's EU privacy rights for all consumers in 2018. High on both: customize by market, with Apple's rival app stores only where required and Meta's ad-free plan sold only in Europe. Low integration, high responsiveness, highlighted: split the firm, with ByteDance's Douyin, TikTok, and a U.S. venture. The quadrant that is low on both is empty. Below the grid, in a dashed box: off the grid, leave the market, with Google's search moved to Hong Kong in 2010 and LinkedIn's network closed in China in 2021.
svg.text: OFF THE GRID: LEAVE THE MARKET
